permissions.description: Read content entries.
Create and edit content entries.
Publish/unpublish content entries.
Delete content entries.

DEPRECATED — superseded by the flat media.* permission set registered below. Retained (not deleted) — see the media.* registration block's own comment and docs/decisions/permission-catalog-migration.md for the same migration contract this repo's other permission renames (navigation.manage, integration.manage) have used. Do not register a new dependency on this string.
Change the active theme/presentation settings.

Create and edit the source files inside a theme package (templates, tokens, styles, manifest). Distinct from theme.set, which only chooses among already-validated themes: editing a theme's files can take that theme to status:'invalid', degrading its pages to the built-in fallback body until corrected. Granted to admin (and owner via '*'), not to editor.
List installed plugins and their state.
Enable a plugin.
Disable a plugin.
Read the change-set audit trail.
Revert an applied change set.
Manage front-end members and subscriptions.
Create/disable operator users and principals.
Manage roles, policies, and grants.

DEPRECATED — superseded by the fine-grained settings.* catalog below. Retained until the data migration that maps existing grants to settings.workspace.write + settings.definitions.manage completes and is verified; do not reuse this string for anything else afterward. See docs/decisions/permission-catalog-migration.md for the migration's completion criteria.
Issue and revoke API keys.
Set/clear a setting's global-layer value.
Set/clear a setting's workspace-layer value.
Set/clear a setting's own user-layer value.
Set/clear another principal's user-layer value.

Read another principal's user-layer value. The read-side counterpart of settings.user.write — gates the ?principalId= cross-principal path on the settings read routes (get-raw/get-effective), which previously had no read permission of its own and borrowed settings.user.write.
Register/rename/retype/deprecate/tombstone setting definitions; also gates the purge service and authorizes the background coerce repair job.
Reset a namespace's global-layer values to defaults.
Reset a namespace's workspace-layer values to defaults.
Reset a namespace's user-layer values to defaults.
Read effective setting values (getEffective).
Read per-layer raw setting values. Reserved for a future API surface.
Read the setting_revisions ledger. Reserved for a future API surface.
List setting definitions grouped by namespace.

DEPRECATED — superseded by the admin.menus.* catalog below. Retained (not deleted) until the Point of No Return: a persistent identity store shipping plus a real deprecation window with observed zero reliance on this string, gated on authorize()-decision logging existing first to measure that. See docs/decisions/permission-catalog-migration.md. Do not register a new dependency on this string.
Read menus and their location bindings.
Create a new menu.
Replace a menu's item tree.
Trash a menu, and attempt an ordinary (non-forced) hard purge.
Force-purge a menu past the dangling-location-binding guard — split from admin.menus.delete so force-purge is not reachable with only the ordinary delete grant.
Assign (or reassign) a menu to a theme location.
Umbrella grant covering every admin.menus.* action (mirrors owner-tier convenience grants).

DEPRECATED — superseded by admin.integrations.manage below, mirroring the navigation.manage -> admin.menus.* precedent. Retained (not deleted) — see admin.integrations.manage's own comment and docs/decisions/permission-catalog-migration.md for the same migration contract this repo's other permission renames have used.
Create, update, pause, and delete webhook subscriptions; read delivery logs.
Read and write per-entry SEO overrides, site-level SEO settings, and the sitemap cache.
Read and change the visitor-facing AI assistant's settings, including its master on/off switch.
Read recent ingested analytics hits.
Create, update, tombstone, import, and read hit stats for redirect rules.
Create, update, and disable/enable form definitions.
List and view form submissions.
Permanently delete a form submission.
List and read newsletter campaigns, lists, and the send log.
Create/edit/cancel a newsletter campaign in draft or scheduled state.
Schedule a draft newsletter campaign to send at a future time.
Send, pause, or resume a newsletter campaign — real outbound mail.
Send a test copy of a newsletter campaign to a small address list.
Create and archive newsletter subscriber lists.
Read newsletter subscriptions and the per-campaign send log.
Add, import, remove newsletter subscriptions, and resend confirmation emails.
Reserved for a future API surface (no route uses this yet).
Umbrella newsletter permission. Reserved for a future API surface (no route uses this yet).

DEPRECATED — superseded by database.read below, mirroring this catalog's integration.manage -> admin.integrations.manage precedent. Retained (not deleted) — see database.read's own comment and docs/decisions/permission-catalog-migration.md for the same migration contract this repo's other permission renames have used.
Read the Database Timeline, schema drift status, and restore points.
Read boot/readiness module lifecycle status.

DEPRECATED — superseded by database.migrate below, mirroring this catalog's integration.manage -> admin.integrations.manage precedent. Retained (not deleted) — see database.migrate's own comment and docs/decisions/permission-catalog-migration.md for the same migration contract this repo's other permission renames have used.
Plan, confirm, and execute a forward schema migration.
Read restore points and the workspace's restore capability.
Mint a restore point independent of any migration.
Confirm and execute a restore to a prior restore point.
Read comments and the moderation queue.
Approve, mark spam, or restore a comment.
Post an operator reply to a comment thread.
Trash a comment (soft delete, recoverable).
Purge a comment permanently (hard delete, not recoverable).
Reserved for a future member-only submission gate; the anonymous path is ingress-governed, not authorize()-gated.
Change Comments settings (moderation defaults, spam threshold, depth cap).
List Collections content types and their entries.
Create/edit content types and entries; deprecate/reactivate/tombstone a content type; publish/unpublish an entry.
Read and write taxonomies, terms, and term assignments (one permission for this whole domain, no .read/.write split).
List and read media assets.
Upload a new media asset.
Edit a media asset's metadata (title/alt/caption/credit).
Trash (soft-delete) a media asset.
Permanently purge a trashed media asset, past the still-referenced guard.
Mint a short-TTL signed URL to download a media asset's original bytes. Reserved for a future API surface — no route uses this yet.
Upload an SVG asset (sanitized at ingest, served origin-isolated).
Umbrella grant covering every media.* action (mirrors owner-tier convenience grants like admin.menus.manage).
Read widget instances, widget_area regions, and their revision history.
Create a new widget instance.
Update an existing widget instance's config.
Bind/reorder/disable a widget in a region's widget_area, or insert/remove/reorder a widgetEmbed node.
Trash a widget instance.
Force-purge a widget instance past the still-referenced guard, flagging any resulting dangling references.
List/view/rename/delete the workspace.

migrations.reason: Internal audit F2 remediation (2026-07-29): the cross-principal settings read path was gated on settings.user.write for lack of a read-side permission. settings.user.read now gates it; every existing write-holder gains the explicit read grant so no operator loses a shipped capability. Unlike this file's other pairs, `from` is not deprecated — it stays live for writes.
navigation.manage split into per-action admin.menus.* strings; every policy holding the old flat permission must not be silently narrowed by the split.
integration.manage renamed to admin.integrations.manage; every policy holding the old flat permission must not be silently locked out by the rename.
Naming-correction: storage.read renamed to database.read; every policy holding the old flat permission must not be silently locked out by the rename.
Naming-correction: storage.migrate renamed to database.migrate; every policy holding the old flat permission must not be silently locked out by the rename.
media.write replaced by the flat media.* permission set; every policy holding the old flat permission must not be silently narrowed by the split.
